name: Centre for the Governance of AI (GovAI)
summary: A research organisation, led by Ben Garfinkel, that studies how governments and AI companies can manage the risks of advanced AI and advises them, and trains people for the field through fellowships and one-year research positions. It began at Oxford's Future of Humanity Institute about ten years ago and became an independent US charity (Centre for the Governance of AI Inc, EIN 99-4000294) in 2024, with a UK subsidiary (company 15883729) running its London office.
